description: Publish Markdown as a PostMD web page. No API key required — anyone can publish. Returns docCode and data.shareUrl; hand shareUrl to people. Documents have a 30-day retention period (data.retainedUntil) that extends on each read. Documents without a password can be updated or deleted by anyone; password-protected documents require the password or the owner's API key. With an API key the document belongs to that member; groupId files it into that group (key with documents:write). The returned docCode can be kept at the top of the source file in a `postmd:document` comment (format at /docs/api) so a later session finds the document.

fileName.description: Upload filename, must end in .md. Default document.md.

groupId.description: File the document in this group instead of the default group (needs an API key).

markdown.description: Full Markdown document as one UTF-8 string (the entire source, not a summary). May include graph data in an HTML comment, which the viewer draws; the format is at /docs/graph.

password.description: Readers must supply this password to see the content.

title.description: Shown in the viewer and link previews. Defaults to fileName without .md.

viewerStyle.description: Viewer theme: readable (default), github, minimal, report, pamphlet or dark. Unknown values fall back to readable.

name: postmd_create_document
